I am a computational neuroscientist at the
[Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies (FIAS)](https://fias.institute)
and Goethe University Frankfurt, in the group of
[Matthias Kaschube](https://fias.institute/en/research/life-and-neurosciences/research-groups/matthias-kaschube/).

I study how reliable sensory representations emerge during the development of
the visual cortex, combining recurrent network models with chronic imaging data
from ferret visual cortex. I submitted my PhD thesis in January 2026.
